title: HookInput
description: The OPA `input` document seen by hook-path Rego rules. Mirrors the JSON tags of policy.HookInput (engine.go) exactly; hookinput_schema_test.go fails if the two drift.

tool_input.description: Raw tool_input from the hook. Free-form by design: the key set is the tool's, not ours, so this stays an untyped object and input.tool_input.<anything> remains legal.

repo_root.description: Optional (omitempty). Git repo root resolved by the daemon; undefined when not a git repo.

aws_account.description: Optional (omitempty). AWS account id resolved from `aws --profile <name>`; undefined for non-AWS commands.

command_binaries.description: Optional (omitempty). Command binary basenames parsed out of a Bash tool_input.command; undefined for non-Bash tools.
